text: Guam is a United States overseas territory. As such, it is counted as **the US** for country streaks purposes.
text_zh: 關島是美國的海外屬性。因此，在連續猜測國家（country streaks）的用途中，它被視為**美國**。

text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an **antenna** at the front right and a tiny part of the **roof rack** can be seen.
NOTE: You will not see a roof rack on the Northern Mariana Islands Google car.
text_zh: 整輛 Google 車都有模糊處理，但在右前方可以看到一根**天線**以及**車頂架**的一小部分。
注意：在北馬利安納群島的 Google 車上你看不到車頂架。

text: Poles on Guam are almost always **concrete** and commonly very thick.
NOTE: Northern Mariana Islands typically have wooden poles.
text_zh: 關島的電線桿幾乎都是**水泥**製的，且通常非常粗。
注意：北馬利安納群島通常使用木製電線桿。

text: Guam uses **green** street signs, unlike the Northern Mariana Islands, which use blue street signs.
text_zh: 關島使用**綠色**的街道標誌，這點與使用藍色街道標誌的北馬利安納群島不同。

text: Guam has a **tropical climate** with a lot of dense and somewhat low vegetation.
text_zh: 關島擁有**熱帶氣候**，且有許多濃密且相對矮小的植被。

text: Both Guam and Northern Mariana Islands often have a very **large number** of **road reflectors**.
text_zh: 關島和北馬利安納群島通常都有**數量極多**的**道路反光標記**。

text: **East Asian languages** such as Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and even Russian are common to see in Guam.
NOTE: This is also the case in Northern Mariana Islands.
text_zh: 在關島很常看到日文、中文、韓文甚至是俄文等**東亞語言**。
注意：北馬利安納群島也是如此。

text: Coverage in Guam is fairly limited, particularly in the southern half, where there is almost no coverage inland.
text_zh: 關島的街景覆蓋相當有限，特別是在南部地區，內陸幾乎沒有任何覆蓋。

text: **Hills** are mostly found on the southern half of the island.
text_zh: **丘陵**主要分佈在該島的南部。

text: Similarly, the northern half of the island is mostly **flat**.
text_zh: 同樣地，該島的北部地區大多是**平坦**的。

text: Some Signposts near the town of Apra View are coloured **yellow**.
text_zh: 阿普拉景觀（Apra View）城鎮附近的某些路標是**黃色**的。

text: LeoPalace Resort can be recognised by the white, resort buildings with **orange tiled roofs**, which looks superficially similar to tiled roofs found on [Java](https://goo.gl/maps/E6P4UxfQsHz8wZoe7).
text_zh: 李奧皇宮度假村可以透過帶有**橘色瓦片屋頂**的白色度假村建築來識別，這在表面上看起來類似[爪哇](https://goo.gl/maps/E6P4UxfQsHz8wZoe7)發現的瓦片屋頂。
